Bikol-Naga: Naghuhulat an estudyante sa paradahan nin jeep sa kalsada.
English Translation: The student waits at the jeepney stop on the street.

Bikol-Naga: Nagkurahaw an mga tawo sa maogmang kapiestahan sa banwaan.
English Translation: The people cheered at the joyful fiesta in town.

Bikol-Naga: Naging maogma an gabos sa pagtiripon kan mga mag-iriba.
English Translation: Everyone became happy at the gathering of companions.

Bikol-Naga: Piggirumdom kan lola an mga storya kan kaidto sa Naga.
English Translation: Grandmother recalled the stories of old times in Naga.

Bikol-Naga: Matani-tanos an dalan paduman sa bagong eskwelahan sa banwaan.
English Translation: The path heading to the new school in town is fairly straight.

Bikol-Naga: Nagluto si nanay nin masiram na kakanon.
Maogma an pamilya sa laog kan harong.
English Translation: The family is happy inside the house.

Bikol-Naga: Mag-ingat ka sa paglakaw sa tinampo.
English Translation: Be careful walking on the road.

Bikol-Naga: Maliwanag an bulan sa kalangitan ngunyan.
English Translation: The moon is bright in the sky tonight.
Thank you for all your love.

Bikol-Naga: Magkanta kita nin magayon na kanta.
English Translation: Let us sing a beautiful song.

Bikol-Naga: Mabuot asin masipag an sakong katood.
English Translation: My friend is kind and hardworking.
